text: This report recommends that the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo adopt the values and principles set out in the City of Toronto's Reconciliation Action Plan and Attachment 1 to this report. These values and principles will be the foundation for and guide your Zoo's programs, initiatives and relationships with First Nations, Inuit and Métis Peoples.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the values and principles set out in Attachment 1 to the report (October 6, 2023) from the Director, Indigenous Relations, Toronto Zoo that will guide the Zoo's programs, initiatives and relationships with First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples.
